The '''morrts''' were a furry [[Species/Legends|species]] of [[Parasite/Legends|parasitic]] [[Blood/Legends|bloodsuckers]] native to [[Gamorr/Legends|Gamorr]].

==Biology and appearance==
Morrts were small, [[Slug/Legends|slug-like]] parasites that sucked the [[Blood/Legends|blood]] from their hosts. Their skin gave off mild [[Anesthetic/Legends|anesthetic]].<ref name="slush">{{JournalCite|14|Murder in Slushtime}}</ref> Morrts gave off a "sweetish stink."

==Behavior==
Wild morrts would swarm their target and drain it dry. Domesticated morrts were very tame and docile, and could easily be removed by their tails.<ref name="slush" />

==History==
The native [[Gamorrean/Legends|Gamorreans]] had great affection for these creatures and found them adorable. The number of morrts feeding on a Gamorrean was a status symbol among [[Gender/Legends|males]] with clan leaders and warriors having up to twenty of these creatures feeding on them at a time.
